meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Use this when the user asks to search memory, "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or wants work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速找回之前会话中解决过的问题和做法
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常想从过往对话里快速找回答案。
copy.tagline_en: Recall past solutions and how you did things before.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to dig up answers from earlier conversations.

howto.what: 用户问起以往会话时,Claude 会先搜索跨会话记忆库,返回带 ID 的索引列表,再查看相关时间线,最后只读取筛选出的完整记录。
howto.when: 当用户问到的是之前会话的内容(如“之前解决过吗”“上次怎么做的 X”),而不是当前对话时触发。

say.text: 我们上次是怎么解决登录超时的?
say.note: 它会去搜历史记录,再告诉你当时的做法。

say.text: 上周这个项目里发生过什么?
say.note: 它会按时间线整理那几天的相关记录。

say.text: 把第 11131 条记录的完整内容调出来。
say.note: 它会直接取回这条记忆的全文。

howto.what_en: When the user asks about earlier sessions, Claude searches the cross-session memory index, shows the results with IDs, inspects relevant timeline context, and only loads full details for the filtered records.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about work from previous sessions (e.g. “did we already solve this?”, “how did we do X last time?”), rather than the current conversation.

say_en.text: How did we fix the login timeout last time?
say_en.note: It searches past records and tells you what we did.

say_en.text: What happened in this project last week?
say_en.note: It pulls the timeline around those days.

say_en.text: Fetch the full content of record 11131.
say_en.note: It retrieves that memory entry in full.
